body: We don't have support for 64-bit DWARF in the gcc RISC-V port, so yes, this is always DW_EH_PE_sdata4 currently.  I don't anticipate that we will ever need 64-bit DWARF.  If someone does insist on adding support for that, then we will need a R_RISCV_64_PCREL relocation which does not exist yet.  Most gcc ports don't bother to support 64-bit DWARF.  It is only useful if you have binaries over 4GB in size, and if you do have binaries that big then you probably have other more important problems than unwind info.

body: Technically, the R_RISCV_ADD32 and R_RISCV_SUB32 relocations are only required when linker relaxation is enabled, since otherwise we can't know the size of the function until after linker relaxation.  Unfortunately, the toolchain currently emits the relocs always.  There is an open bug report somewhere asking us to fix this, so in the future these relocs may not be present when linker relaxation is disabled.
